audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows Skill on all 7 rows while content win[] and the packet both read Ahri/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Qiyana/Ahri.
audit.why: The two layers must agree; content and packet agree with each other, so the full sides are moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page called Ahri 'he' in 16 fields, referenced a nonexistent 'post-combo silence' on Ahri, and never stated that Charm instantly stops movement abilities (it eats Qiyana's E/R mid-flight) or that Orb's return is true damage.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'instantly stopping movement abilities'. Q text: 'true damage on the way back'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere; silence line replaced with a Charm-cooldown trigger; true damage and Essence Theft sustain folded in.

audit.why: Trade pattern (stealth Q poke, E-string when Charm down, avoid open-ground combos) is sound.
Charm is 12s all ranks, Spirit Rush 140/120/100, Qiyana R 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite Essence Theft sustain; missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated (Q true damage).
audit.why: Ahri heals per 9 minions and on takedowns; Orb return ignores resistances.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds note added to breakdown.mid; true damage named in enemyWin.
